title: Modification in premium rates due to revised Commission/Remuneration Structure and introduction of Reward System
full_text:
• **JI INSURANCE REGULATORY AND iatai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** 

# Ref: IRDA/HL T/REG/CIR/064/03/2017 

24<sup>th</sup> March, 2017 

The CMDs / Chief Executive Officers of Health Insurers 

# **_Re: Modification in premium rates due to revised Commission/Remuneration Structure and introduction of Reward System_** 

Reference is invited to Circular No. IRDAI/NL/CIR/F&U/060/03/2017 dated 22<sup>nd</sup> March 2017 on Modification in premium rates due to revised Commission/Remuneration Structure and introduction of Reward System issued to all General Insurers.It is clarified that the within referred circular is mutatis mutandis applicable to insurance prod ucts offered by all Health Insurance Companies also. 

These instructions are issued under the powers vested in Regulation 2 (i) (o) of IRDAI (Health Insurance) Regulations, 2016
